arxiv-2004-04994.title: High-Dimensional Pixel Entanglement: Efficient Generation and Certification
arxiv-2004-04994.creator: Natalia Herrera Valencia, Vatshal Srivastav, Matej Pivoluska, Marcus Huber, Nicolai Friis, Will McCutcheon, Mehul Malik
arxiv-2004-04994.description: Abstract Photons offer the potential to carry large amounts of information in their spectral, spatial, and polarisation degrees of freedom. While state-of-the-art classical communication systems routinely aim to maximize this information-carrying capacity via wavelength and spatial-mode division multiplexing, quantum systems based on multi-mode entanglement usually suffer from low state quality, long measurement times, and limited encoding capacity.

arxiv-2105-10591.title: Heterogeneous Treatment Effects in Social Networks
arxiv-2105-10591.creator: Amir Gilad, Harsh Parikh * †, Sudeepa Roy †, Babak Salimi
arxiv-2105-10591.description: Abstract We study treatment effect modifiers for causal analysis in a social network, where neighbors’ characteristics or network structure may affect the outcome of a unit, and the goal is to identify sub-populations with varying treatment effects using such network properties.

arxiv-2109-12456.title: Auditing AI models for Verified Deployment under Semantic Specifications
arxiv-2109-12456.creator: Homanga Bharadhwaj, De-An Huang, Chaowei Xiao, Animashree Anandkumar, Animesh Garg
arxiv-2109-12456.description: Abstract Auditing trained deep learning (DL) models prior to deployment is vital for preventing unintended consequences. One of the biggest challenges in auditing is the lack of human-interpretable specifications for the DL models that are directly useful to the auditor.

arxiv-2301-06019.title: Proportion of blocking curves in a pencil
arxiv-2301-06019.creator: Shamil Asgarli, Dragos Ghioca, Chi Hoi Yip
arxiv-2301-06019.description: Abstract . Let ℒ \mathcal{L} be a pencil of plane curves defined over 𝔽 q \mathbb{F}_{q} with no 𝔽 q \mathbb{F}_{q} -points in its base locus. We investigate the number of curves in ℒ \mathcal{L} whose 𝔽 q \mathbb{F}_{q} -points form a blocking set.

arxiv-2305-10931.title: Lyapunov-driven deep reinforcement learning for edge inference empowered by Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces
arxiv-2305-10931.creator: Kyriakos Stylianopoulos, Mattia Merluzzi, Paolo Di Lorenzo, George C. Alexandropoulos
arxiv-2305-10931.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose a novel algorithm for energy-efficient, low-latency, accurate inference at the wireless edge, in the context of 6G networks endowed with reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RISs). We consider a scenario where new data are continuously generated/collected by a set of devices and are handled through a dynamic queueing system.

arxiv-2407-09662.title: Analytical Expression for Continuum-continuum Transition Amplitude of Hydrogen-like Atoms with Angular-momentum Dependence
arxiv-2407-09662.creator: J B Ji, K Ueda, M Han, H J Wörner
arxiv-2407-09662.description: Abstract Attosecond chronoscopy typically utilises interfering two-photon transitions to access the phase information. Simulating these two-photon transitions is challenging due to the continuum-continuum transition term. The hydrogenic approximation within second-order perturbation theory has been widely used due to the existence of analytical expressions of the wave functions.

arxiv-2411-14544.title: Interpreting seasonal and interannual Hadley cell descending edge migrations via the cell-mean Rossby number
arxiv-2411-14544.creator: Spencer A. Hill, \aff a Simona Bordoni, \aff b Jonathan L. Mitchell, \aff c,d Juan M. Lora, \aff e
arxiv-2411-14544.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Spencer A. Hill, \aff a Simona Bordoni, \aff b Jonathan L. Mitchell, \aff c,d Juan M. Lora, \aff e. The poleward extent of Earth’s zonal-mean Hadley cells varies across seasons and years, which would be nice to capture in a simple theory. A plausible, albeit diagnostic, candidate from Hill et al.

arxiv-2503-15679.title: Sequential learning based PINNs to overcome temporal domain complexities in unsteady flow past flapping wings
arxiv-2503-15679.creator: Rahul Sundar, Didier Lucor, Sunetra Sarkar
arxiv-2503-15679.description: Abstract For a data-driven and physics combined modelling of unsteady flow systems with moving immersed boundaries, Sundar et al. [ 1 ] introduced an immersed boundary-aware (IBA) framework, combining Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) and the immersed boundary method (IBM). This approach was beneficial because it avoided case-specific transformations to a body-attached reference frame.

arxiv-2506-02344.title: Memory Access Vectors: Improving Sampling Fidelity for CPU Performance Simulations
arxiv-2506-02344.creator: Sriyash Caculo, Mahesh Madhav, Jeff Baxter
arxiv-2506-02344.description: Abstract Accurate performance projection of large-scale benchmarks is essential for CPU architects to evaluate and optimize future processor designs. SimPoint sampling, which uses Basic Block Vectors (BBVs), is a widely adopted technique to reduce simulation time by selecting representative program phases. However, BBVs often fail to capture the behavior of applications with extensive array-indirect memory accesses, leading to inaccurate projections.

arxiv-2507-04444.title: Data Discovery using LLMs - A Study of Data User Behaviour
arxiv-2507-04444.creator: Christin Katharina Kreutz, Anja Perry, Tanja Friedrich
arxiv-2507-04444.description: Abstract Data search for scientific research is more complex than a simple web search. The emergence of large language models (LLMs) and their applicability for scientific tasks offers new opportunities for researchers who are looking for data, e.g., to freely express their data needs instead of fitting them into restrictions of data catalogues and portals.

arxiv-2510-11565.title: SNAP: Towards Segmenting Anything in Any Point Cloud
arxiv-2510-11565.creator: Aniket Gupta, Hanhui Wang, Charles Saunders, Aruni RoyChowdhury, Hanumant Singh, Huaizu Jiang
arxiv-2510-11565.description: Abstract Interactive 3D point cloud segmentation enables efficient annotation of complex 3D scenes through user-guided prompts. However, current approaches are typically restricted in scope to a single domain (indoor or outdoor), and to a single form of user interaction (either spatial clicks or textual prompts).

arxiv-2511-00157.title: Nucleosynthesis and CMB bounds on photophilic ALPs: a fresh look
arxiv-2511-00157.creator: Miguel Escudero Abenza, Clara Garcia-Perez, Maksym Ovchynnikov
arxiv-2511-00157.description: Abstract We provide a fresh look at the cosmological constraints on axion-like particles (ALPs) that couple predominantly to photons, focusing on lifetimes τ a ≲ 10 4 ​ s \tau_{a}\lesssim 10^{4}\,{\rm s} and masses m a ≲ 10 ​ GeV m_{a}\lesssim 10\,{\rm GeV} .

pmc-10520414.creator: Ahtesham Khizar, Soha Zahid, Pradhumna Kumar Yadav
pmc-10520414.description: A 1‐year‐old girl presented with an overly enlarged head for 5 months. Negligence of parents regarding treatment for this enlarged head is concerning. Early treatment can avoid a lot of complications. Hydrocephalus secondary to aqueductal stenosis was diagnosed after a thorough history, examination, and investigations. Endoscopic third ventriculostomy was performed.

pmc-10758639.title: A retrospective analysis of ibrutinib outcomes in relapsed or refractory mantle cell lymphoma
pmc-10758639.creator: Yong-Pyo Lee, Ye Ji Jung, Junhun Cho, Young Hyeh Ko, Won Seog Kim, Seok Jin Kim, Sang Eun Yoon
pmc-10758639.description: BackgroundWhile treatment strategies for mantle cell lymphoma (MCL) have evolved, patients often experience disease progression and require additional treatment therapies. Ibrutinib presents a promising option for relapsed or refractory MCL (RR-MCL). This study investigated real-world treatment outcomes of ibrutinib in patients with RR-MCL.MethodsA single-center retrospective analysis investigated clinical characteristics and survival outcomes of patients with RR-MCL, treated with ibrutinib.

pmc-11325829.title: Association between neutrophil‐to‐lymphocyte ratio and length of hospital stay in an acute psychiatric hospital: A cross‐sectional study
pmc-11325829.creator: Rikako Tsuji, Yuto Hiura, Yuki Ishikura, Toshinari Sueyoshi, Naoaki Sho, Naoki Narushima, Takeshi Haoka, Atsushi Terao, Akira Kikuchi
pmc-11325829.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). AimThe available evidence for predicting length of stay in acute psychiatric hospitals includes demographics, diagnosis, and treatment variables. This study aimed to evaluate the association between neutrophil‐to‐lymphocyte ratio (NLR) and length of hospital stay in an acute psychiatric hospital.MethodsA total of 116 patients who were admitted to an acute psychiatric ward at Urawa Neuropsychiatric Sanatorium (Saitama, Japan) from August 2022 to December 2022 were eligible for this study.

pmc-11415931.title: Health assessment of nesting loggerhead sea turtles (Caretta caretta) in one of their largest rookeries (central eastern Florida coast, USA)
pmc-11415931.creator: Nicole I Stacy, Rachel Smith, Kathleen E Sullivan, Steven E Nelson Jr, Elizabeth C Nolan, Ryan S De Voe, Blair E Witherington, Justin R Perrault, Jennifer Provencher
pmc-11415931.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Reproduction is a physiologically demanding process for sea turtles. Health indicators, including morphometric indices and blood analytes, provide insight into overall health, physiology and organ function for breeding sea turtles as a way to assess population-level effects. The Archie Carr National Wildlife Refuge (ACNWR) on Florida’s central eastern coast is critical nesting habitat for loggerhead sea turtles (Caretta caretta), but health variables from this location have not been documented.

pmc-12436874.title: The misdiagnose of psychosis and its implications in some cultures. The experience of Doctors Without Borders (MSF) in South Sudan and Chad
pmc-12436874.creator: C Carreño Glaria
pmc-12436874.description: IntroductionIn certain cultures psychological suffering is expressed with more somatic symptoms. Besides, they tend to describe more often hallucinations and other forms of perception problems.ObjectivesTo describe and warn about the risks of misdiagnose when culture is not an element considered in the diagnosis.MethodsDescriptive methodology based on practice and observation.

pmc-13158164.title: Deciphering Bax Dynamics: Regulation, Retrotranslocation, and Mitochondrial Interplay in the Commitment to Apoptosis: A Narrative Review
pmc-13158164.creator: Mehrin Haque Tanisha, Md. Ayman Siddique, Zubaier Ahmed, Nashrah Mustafa, Fariha Tasneem
pmc-13158164.description: BackgroundThe apoptotic pathway mediated by mitochondria depends on the activation of pro‐apoptotic Bcl‐2 proteins Bax and Bak. When they permeabilize the outer mitochondrial membrane (OMM), mitochondrial dysfunction occurs, leading to caspase activation. A recent study proposed that Bax accumulation on mitochondria increases apoptotic susceptibility, with adhesion‐initiated signals regulating Bax.

pmc-13232855.title: A study of trends and projection of life expectancy and its association with socio-demographic index: Results from GBD study 2023
pmc-13232855.creator: Reza Taherian, Maryam Karimi Ghahfarokhi, Farid Zayeri
pmc-13232855.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundLife expectancy (LE) serves as a central indicator of population health, reflecting the combined effects of social, economic, and demographic factors. Despite global improvements, substantial disparities persist across regions and development levels.

pmc-13353156.creator: Min Jae Kim, Koo Bok Chin
pmc-13353156.description: ObjectiveThis study evaluated the effects of chickpea powder (CPP) drying method (freeze-drying [FD] and oven-drying [OD]), and concentration (1.0% and 1.5%) on the quality characteristics of CPP-containing emulsified model sausages (EMSs), using a conventional emulsion-type meat system. CPP was assessed as a plant-based alternative to soy protein isolate (SPI), which is commonly used in meat formulations.

pmc-13411744.title: Pediatric osmotic demyelination syndrome triggered by post-traumatic pituitary stalk injury: a case report
pmc-13411744.creator: Maolin Sheng, Ming Zhang, Weifeng Lu
pmc-13411744.description: BackgroundOsmotic demyelination syndrome (ODS) is an acute neurological disorder resulting from demyelination, typically triggered by rapid osmotic shifts. This syndrome is rare in adults and even more uncommon in children.To date, no reported cases have documented ODS secondary to hyponatremia caused by post-traumatic pituitary stalk injury.
